Impact: Incorrect organization may fail to meet the required submission structure.

Description: A cpu_pkg package must contain all CPU-related definitions.
Impact: Package contents or compilation dependencies may need adjustment.

Description: A simple program must import cpu_pkg and test the CPU and its objects.
Scope: Test program; CPU and ALU classes
Impact: The deliverable may be incomplete if no test program is provided.

Description: The common base_alu properties are operand_A (int), operand_B (int), alu_op (Enum), and alu_result (int).
Impact: Changing property names or types may conflict with the stated specification.

Description: logical_alu and arithmetic_alu are derived from base_alu.
Impact: A different hierarchy would not match the stated design.

Description: CPU contains logical_alu l_alu and arithmetic_alu a_alu.
Impact: Different member names/types may conflict with the specification.

Description: Operation codes are presented as 4-bit values from 4'b0000 through 4'b1101 for the listed operations.
Scope: ALU operation selection; FR-006; FR-007; IF-014
Impact: Changing codes may cause operation mismatches in implementation and tests.

Description: Use of extern for class functions is optional.
Impact: Treating extern as mandatory would add an unsupported constraint.

Description: The assignment does not specify detailed behavior for invalid or unsupported operation codes.
Impact: Implementation and tests need an agreed policy for unsupported codes.

Description: The assignment does not define exact reset/initialization values or sequence.
Impact: Different implementations may reset object state differently.

Description: Carry and borrow inputs/outputs and their conventions are not fully defined.
Scope: Arithmetic operations OP-005 and OP-007, and related operations
Impact: Arithmetic results may differ depending on carry/borrow interpretation.

Description: Shift/rotate operand mapping, amount source, and data width are not specified.
Impact: Implementations may behave differently for shifts and rotations.

Description: The assignment does not specify operand width, signedness, overflow, or underflow behavior beyond the declared int types.
Impact: Boundary results may differ across implementation choices.

Description: The enum name and exact declaration are not specified, although operation properties/parameters use an Enum type.
Impact: The enum declaration and package interface may need clarification.

Description: Exact method signatures and return behavior for display, load_operand_A, load_operand_B, and initialize are not fully specified.
Impact: Method declarations and calling code may need adjustment.

Description: The exact behavior of selecting data on port B is not elaborated beyond the operation name and code.
Impact: The selected value and result assignment may need clarification.
